Emma Heathcote-James (Founder, Little Soap Company Ⓥ BCorp™ - Queen’s Award for Enterprise. Ambassador for King’s Awards, Made in Britain, Be The Business. Championing Autistic Girls Network and The Haven online school for different minds.)
🎥 If you'd told me on Wednesday night where we’d be and what we'd be doing with some of our Sales & Marketing over the weekend I'd never have believed you!

📞 And then one call on Wednesday night changed everything....

It was one of those say yes and work it out later opportunities which, after a lot of paperwork and dropping all to make it happen gave us all a not only a weekend of celebrating all the hard work for our The King's Awards for Enterprise and upcoming launch next week (more then) but it was also a once in a lifetime weekend of bonding, laughter and memory making! 

📺 The result is Little Soap Company - BCorp™  will be making a very small and fleeting contribution to an episode to a well known series on TV in early 2027 - when rest assured, you'll hear ALLLL about it from us (and at length 😂!) but in the meantime we need to now try and forget it ever happened 🤐 

🍾I did manage to get one of the empty champagne bottles back in one piece in my hand luggage though, which I plan to get melted and flattened to hang on the office wall - so in the meantime, when I pinch myself wondering if it was all a dream, I can also look up at it and know it really did happen! 

#entrepreneurlife #sayyes #seizetheday
